identity.title: [C-SDLC v2] Add typed STP deliverable correction after review recovery

review_prompts: Can any issue without typed review recovery invoke the operation?
Can the operation modify any field other than STP deliverables?
Does audit evidence retain both exact previous and replacement values?
Do negative tests cover every phase, wrong card, stale CAS, malformed input, and projection drift?
Does the design avoid weakening review and publication authority?

findings.summary: SPP steps S1-S3 remained pending after implementation and validation completed.
Focused proof covered stale generation but not stale digest and unchanged durable state.

residual_risk: The operation is intentionally narrow and remains unavailable until this exact reviewed binary is installed; issue #73 consumption is the final pre-publication integration proof.
